name: delta
meaning: the mover's displacement for this step, which a registered rider may change (BlackHole_ApplyPull reads it from 0x49b1c6)

name: flag0
meaning: bit 0 of the flags word; no reader identified

name: noPull
meaning: bit 1: pullers leave this move alone - BlackHole_HandleMessage skips ApplyPull (mov dx,[ecx+6]; shr dx; and dx,1 at 0x49b3b3-0x49b3c5) and Magnet skips PullMover on the same bit

name: flag2
meaning: bit 2: ScnControllable::ApplyMoveModifiers sets it from its fifth argument (or 4 / and 0xfffb on the payload at 0x4920bd-0x4920d4)

name: velocity
meaning: the mover's velocity; BlackHole_ApplyPull adds signed 16-bit components to it (0x49b2e8-0x49b320)
